data.description: The list of engagement metrics for the publication within the specified date range and granularity. Returns an empty list if there is no engagement data for the specified period.

date.description:
The starting date of the period for which the engagement metrics are reported based on the selected granularity.

`day` granularity: The specific day.
`week` granularity: The Monday of the week.
`month` granularity: The first day of the month.

total_opens.description: The total number of times emails were opened during the period.

unique_opens.description: The number of unique subscribers who opened emails during the period.

total_clicks.description: The total number of times links were clicked during the period.

total_verified_clicks.description: The total number of times links were clicked, during the period, as verified by our system.

unique_clicks.description: The number of unique subscribers who clicked links during the period.

unique_verified_clicks.description: The number of times links were clicked by unique subscribers, during the period, as verified by our system.

start_date.description: The starting date of the engagement metrics.

number_of_days.description: The number of days to return engagement metrics for, starting from `start_date`. Must be between 1 and 31. Defaults to `1` if not provided.

granularity.description: The granularity at which to report the engagement metrics. Defaults to `day` if not provided.

email_type.description:
Filter engagement metrics by email type. If omitted, all email engagement is included.
`post`: Only post emails.
`message`: Only automated and system-generated emails.

direction.description:
The direction that the results are sorted in. Defaults to `asc`.

`desc`: Newest to oldest

status.description:
The status of the subscription.
`validating` - The email address is being validated.
`invalid` - The email address is invalid.
`pending` - The email address is valid, but the subscription is pending double opt-in.
`active` - The email was valid and the subscription is active.
`inactive` - The subscription was made inactive, possibly due to an unsubscribe.
`needs_attention` - The subscription requires approval or denial.
`paused` - The subscriber has paused their subscription.

id.description: The prefixed ID of the subscription.

status.description:
The status of the subscription.
`validating` - The email address is being validated.
`invalid` - The email address is invalid.
`pending` - The email address is valid, but the subscription is pending double opt-in.
`active` - The email was valid and the subscription is active.
`inactive` - The subscription was made inactive, possibly due to an unsubscribe.
`needs_attention` - The subscription requires approval or denial.

utm_medium.description: The acquisition medium; how the subscriber got to your publication

utm_term.description: The acquisition term; typically the keyword or search term

utm_content.description: The acquisition content; typically used for A/B testing or ad variations

referring_site.description: The website that the subscriber was referred from

kind.description: The type of value being stored in the custom field.

tags.description:
Optional list of tags for a subscription. Retrievable by including `expand: [tags]` in the request body.

stats.description: Optional list of stats for a subscription. Retrievable by including `expand: [stats]` in the request body.

emails_received.description: The total number of emails that have been sent to this subscriber

open_rate.description: The percentage of emails that the subscriber has opened

click_through_rate.description: The percentage of emails that the subscriber has clicked a link in

email.description: The email address to search for subscriptions

expand.description:
Optionally expand the results by adding additional information.
`subscription` - Returns the full Subscription object for the email address in each publication.
`publication` - Returns the full Publication object instead of just ID and name.
`subscription_custom_fields` - Returns custom field values nested within the subscription object. (Returns the subscription object regardless of whether `subscription` is requested.)
